info.title: Resolve API
info.description: Automated resolution infrastructure for long-tail prediction markets. Verdicts are contract-validated; UNRESOLVED always carries a caveat; a non-observation is never a negative verdict. Percentages in the track record appear only after 100 reconciled events per platform (the legs of one multi-outcome event count once).

engine_version.description: Opaque label of the resolution engine version behind a web-evidence verdict; it changes when the engine changes. null when no web-evidence call was made.

post.summary: Resolve a market from stored or inline evidence (bill-then-run; Idempotency-Key supported)

200.description: Verdict (or StrictV0Verdict for strict_v0 tenants) plus request_id, credits_charged, credits_refunded, balance, route (precheck | structured | web_evidence)

202.description: Idempotent replay of a request still in flight

402.description: insufficient_credits (price_credits, balance, route and top_up: {method: "card", checkout: "POST /v1/billing/checkout", page: "<site>/pricing#pay-by-card", packs[] {pack, price, currency, credits}} while card checkout is offered, else {method: "contact_support", page: "<site>/terms#contact"}; never a USDC address, at top level; the message says the same)

409.description: conflict: fetch:true while a poll of the market's watch is in progress (a scheduled dispatch or another fetch holds it); nothing ran, retry in a minute

422.description: strict_v0 tenants: UNSAFE_INPUT with no verdict body

429.description: rate_limited | daily_cap_reached with remaining, resets_at, retry_after_seconds, how_to_proceed

503.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: billing or model unavailable, or the watch lease for fetch:true could not be taken (no credits charged), or error_reason VERDICT_NOT_RECORDED: the verdict could not be stored, the charge is refunded (credits_refunded) and a replay of that Idempotency-Key answers the same; retry with a new key

post.summary: Register a market and its watches in one transaction. Sources must match their kind (GitHub: repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}, issues/{n}, releases, releases/tags/{tag}, events, or the repository itself for a numeric_threshold resolver; base_log: base:0x + 40 hex; solana_log: solana:<account>), name the resolver's own repo, PR, contract or account, and web sources must be public https URLs on the default port; web_render is not accepted yet. At registration: robots.txt (a disallow = unsupported_source; a robots.txt that answers 5xx or 429, or not at all, could not be checked: 503), contract code on Base, and a Solana account that exists and is not a program. Re-registering the same external_id returns the existing market

400.description: validation_error: schema, source policy or a Solana program id

403.description: validation_error: watch limit reached (watch_limit, active_watches, requested_watches at top level)

409.description: conflict: the service's Base watch capacity is reached (max_base_watches, active_base_watches, requested_base_watches at top level)

503.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: a registration check could not be made (Base or Solana RPC, robots.txt); nothing was stored, retry after Retry-After

200.description: markets[]
market, watches

delete.summary: Soft-delete a market and deactivate its watches

200.description: deleted

resolutions[] (id, resolution_status, winning_outcome, confidence_score, error_code, error_reason, caveats, determination_basis, engine_version, thresholds_version, credits_charged, credits_refunded, created_at)

post.summary: Follow a public shadow market (open, not a test market) for the private early reveal: its committed verdicts at GET /v1/shadow/{market_id} and as shadow.committed / shadow.revealed webhooks, labeled "private early reveal — excluded from the public record". Idempotent. Follows of open markets per tenant: 50, Growth 500, Platform unlimited (read from the tenant's plan); a follow of a settled market does not count. A free-plan (evaluation) follow delivers only while the tenant holds a live key

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The market's uuid, or its venue id <platform>:<external_id> (platform polymarket, limitless, custom) exactly as /record and the home page print it. A venue id names only a public shadow market (not a tenant's, not a test market, not deleted); none or more than one match answers 404

200.description: already following: the same fields with already_following=true

201.description: follow_id, market_id (the uuid), market (platform:external_id), following, already_following=false, follows_counted (follows of open markets, what the limit counts), follow_limit (null = unlimited), events, read, endpoints_subscribed (active endpoints that receive shadow.committed), warning (only when endpoints_subscribed is 0)

400.description: validation_error: an id that is neither a uuid nor a venue id, the tenant's own market, or a market no longer open

403.description: validation_error: follow limit reached (follow_limit, follows_counted at top level)

404.description: not_found: no such public shadow market (or a venue id that matches more than one)

delete.summary: Stop following (soft delete); following again later creates a new follow

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The market's uuid, or its venue id <platform>:<external_id> (platform polymarket, limitless, custom) exactly as /record and the home page print it. A venue id names only a public shadow market (not a tenant's, not a test market, not deleted); none or more than one match answers 404

200.description: unfollowed (the market's uuid)

400.description: validation_error: neither a uuid nor a venue id

404.description: not_found: not following this market, or no public shadow market with that venue id

get.summary: Active follows, newest first (at most 1000; active_follows is the full count), with follows_counted (follows of open markets, what the limit counts) and the plan's follow_limit. When follows_counted exceeds the limit (after a plan change), only the oldest follows up to the limit receive early reveals and a warning says so

200.description: follows[] (follow_id, market_id, followed_at, market platform:external_id, status, deadline_utc), active_follows, follows_counted, follow_limit, truncated, warning (only when follows_counted > follow_limit)

get.summary: Export the followed markets this account is entitled to (the same rule as GET /v1/shadow/{market_id}: the plan's follow limit, and a live key on the free plan), one row per market, labeled "private early reveal — excluded from the public record": the latest commitment_sha256, committed_at, committed_status and committed_outcome, the evidence hashes, the number of commits, and once the platform resolves the market, official_outcome, official_at, official_at_source (gamma_closed_time is the platform's timestamp; limitless_api_poll and first_observed_poll are the first poll that saw the outcome, so lead_seconds is an upper bound), agreement and lead_seconds. Never the nonce or the preimage. The oldest 1000 follows are read (truncated says when there are more). format=csv answers RFC 4180 CSV with a header row (Content-Type text/csv; X-Resolve-Truncated); the default is the JSON envelope

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: A UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO 8601 time: rows whose latest commit or final reconciliation was recorded at or after it

200.description: JSON: rows[] (market_id, platform, external_id, event_key, venue_slug, status, committed_at, commitment_sha256, committed_status, committed_outcome, evidence_raw_sha256, evidence_canonical_sha256, n_commits, official_outcome, official_at, official_at_source, agreement, lead_seconds), count, columns, truncated, filters, label, note, disclaimer; or the same rows as CSV

503.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: the follows or the report view could not be read (never an empty export)

get.summary: Private early reveal of a followed market ("private early reveal — excluded from the public record"): every committed verdict, newest first, with its commitment_sha256, committed_at, posted state and evidence hashes. Never the nonce or the preimage: those appear only in the public reveal. 404 unless the tenant follows the market; 403 when the follow is above the plan's follow limit (after a plan change) or a free-plan tenant holds no live key

parameters.name: market_id
parameters.description: The market's uuid, or its venue id <platform>:<external_id> (platform polymarket, limitless, custom) exactly as /record and the home page print it. A venue id names only a public shadow market (not a tenant's, not a test market, not deleted); none or more than one match answers 404

200.description: market_id, platform, external_id, market, status, deadline_utc, label, latest, commits[] (commitment_sha256, committed_at, posted, posted_at, verdict {resolution_status, winning_outcome, confidence_score, caveats, determination_basis, thresholds_version} or null for a pre-v2 commit, evidence {raw_sha256, canonical_sha256}), how_to_verify, disclaimer

403.description: validation_error: the follow is above the plan's follow limit, or the evaluation has ended

200.description: verdict

get.summary: Tenant, plan, credits, the registered sender wallet (wallet_address), when the last credits.low notice went out (low_credit_notified_at, cleared by any purchase or grant), key usage

200.description: tenant, key

get.summary:
Issue a single-use wallet registration challenge (valid 10 minutes) for the wallet this account sends USDC from. The message to sign is exactly "Resolve wallet registration
tenant: <tenant_id>
address: <lowercase address>
nonce: <nonce>
issued: <ISO time>"

200.description: challenge_id, address (lowercase), message, nonce, issued_at, expires_at, sign, submit

400.description: validation_error: address missing or not 0x + 40 hex

post.summary: Register the wallet that signed a challenge (EIP-191 personal_sign of the challenge message; externally owned accounts only). USDC it sends to the receiving address is then credited to this account; it replaces a previously registered wallet

200.description: wallet_address, previous_wallet_address, registered=true

400.description: validation_error: malformed body, or error_reason bad_signature (the signature does not recover to the challenge's address)

404.description: not_found: no such challenge for this account

409.description: validation_error with error_reason challenge_used (single use) or wallet_taken (registered to another account)

get.summary: Credits by reason and resolutions by route over a window

200.description: window_days, credits_by_reason, resolutions_by_route (keys <route>/<resolution_status>, route precheck | structured | web_evidence), recent_ledger

get.summary: Only while USDC deposits are offered (off unless the service switches them on): USDC (Base) receiving address, the PAYG tiers the deposit is credited at (a deposit gets the rate of the highest tier its amount reaches: floor(amount x credits_per_usdc)), the packs they buy, the registered sender wallet, confirmation policy (safe tag). Deposits emit payment.credited. While they are not offered it answers 503 "USDC deposits are not offered" with error_reason USDC_NOT_OFFERED and the card pointer

200.description: chain, token, token_contract, receiving_address, registered_sender_wallet, credits_per_usdc (base rate), payg_tiers[] {min_usdc, credits_per_usdc}, packs[] {usdc, credits, credits_per_usdc}, confirmation_policy, register_wallet

503.description: USDC deposits are not offered (error_reason USDC_NOT_OFFERED, top_up: {method: "card", checkout: "POST /v1/billing/checkout", page: "<site>/pricing#pay-by-card", packs[] {pack, price, currency, credits}} while card checkout is offered, else {method: "contact_support", page: "<site>/terms#contact"}; never a USDC address), deposits not enabled, or pricing unavailable

post.summary: Mint a new key; the calling key expires in 24 h, or at its own expiry if that is sooner. Rotation never extends a key: the new key keeps the calling key's expiry (an evaluation key stays inside its 30 days)

201.description: key (shown once), key_id, expires_at (null = never), note

post.summary: Register an https endpoint (secret shown once). events: a subset of market.resolved, market.unresolved_update, market.error, credits.low, payment.credited, shadow.committed, shadow.revealed (default: all). The first delivery attempt is made as the event happens (a few per event; the rest by the 5-minute queue drain); failed attempts retry on a backoff of 60 s, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 12 h, 24 h, then dead-letter

200.description: endpoints[]
deleted
deliveries[]

post.summary: Replay a delivered or dead-lettered event

200.description: replayed

get.summary: Public track record rendered from v_track_record (60 s cache; test markets excluded; one agreement per market; the legs of one multi-outcome event are one event: n_events_* columns, event_precision; cumulative percentages with 95 % Wilson intervals only after 100 reconciled events per platform)

200.description: rows[] per platform and week; before 100 reconciled events each percentage column holds the gate text

get.summary: Look up a commitment (public, no auth). Before the reveal: market, committed_at, posted, revealed=false (never the nonce). After the reveal: preimage, nonce, committed verdict, official outcome, agreement; sha256(preimage) = commitment_sha256

200.description: commitment_sha256, market (platform:external_id), committed_at, posted, posted_at, message_id (the legs of one event share their commit message), revealed [+ preimage_version, preimage, nonce, committed, official, agreement, reveal_posted once revealed]

post.summary: Open a card checkout (Whop, the merchant of record) for a credit pack for this key's account: "20": $20 for 2,000 credits, "50": $50 for 5,000 credits, "250": $250 for 27,500 credits. Whop receives this account's id, never the key. The credits are added when Whop confirms the payment (usually within a minute; GET /v1/account shows the balance); a free test key's account moves to pay as you go and its key stops expiring. Credits are a non-refundable prepayment for API services and do not expire while the account is open; a card refund or chargeback removes them. Never cached

200.description: checkout_url (Whop's hosted checkout), checkout_id, pack, price, currency, credits, merchant_of_record, note

400.description: validation_error: pack is not one of the packs

503.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: card checkout not yet available, not configured, or Whop did not open the checkout; nothing was charged

post.summary: The pricing page's card form (public HTML; no-store): the key and the pack in the form body, answered with a 303 to the Whop checkout opened for that key's account (the key is never passed on, echoed or kept). Refusals answer an HTML page with the reason

429.description: too many requests for this key

503.description: card checkout not yet available, or the checkout could not be opened; nothing was charged

get.summary: Where Whop sends the buyer after paying (public HTML). It reads nothing: credits come only from Whop's signed confirmation

200.description: text/html

post.summary: Whop's signed payment, refund and dispute events (Standard Webhooks: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp within 300 s, webhook-signature v1 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body). Called by Whop only; an unverified request answers 401 and nothing is stored

200.description: received, type, result

409.description: conflict: another event of the same payment is being processed; Whop retries

503.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: not configured or the database is unavailable; Whop retries

post.summary: Request a test key (public, no auth). Issues an evaluation key on the spot and returns it once (data.key): rsl_test_, 300 credits, valid 30 days, structured verdicts only, up to 5 watches. One key per email address every 30 days, 3 keys a day per network (IPv4 address or IPv6 /64) and a daily cap on keys issued this way (25 by default); past any of these, or when the service is unsure, no key is issued (key_issued=false) and a person answers by email. At most 5 requests per hour per IP address

200.description: received=true, key_issued, note; when key_issued: key (shown once, never stored), key_id, environment, plan, credits, watch_limit, expires_at, docs, and pay_by_card (<site>/pricing#pay-by-card, while card checkout is offered) (JSON); for a form post, an HTML page with the key or a confirmation. Never cached
service, schema_version, thresholds_version, engine_version (opaque engine label), web_evidence_routes_enabled, migrations_applied, git_sha

get.summary: What ResolveBot fetches and why, how it stays polite (declared user agent, robots.txt for web pages, per-page spacing, conditional requests) and how to opt out (robots.txt for web pages; an issue for official releases and public APIs) (public HTML, no auth)

200.description: text/html
